# Freeze a space
To make a published space read-only for everyone, including members and admins, check **Freeze this space** under **Space settings → Access**. Member permissions are kept for when you unfreeze it.

  * Fix: on iOS 27, a home-screen install drew its page title and top-bar buttons underneath the system’s new blurred top edge, leaving them smeared. The top bar now leaves that band clear.

## Run mode
* `SB_READ_ONLY` *(legacy)*: If you want to run the SilverBullet client and server in read-only mode (you get the full SilverBullet client, but all edit functionality and commands are disabled), you can do this by setting this environment variable to a non-empty value. Upon the server start a full space index will happen, after which all write operations will be disabled. Prefer the per-space settings in the [[Dashboard]]: give the public read access to publish a space (see [[Publishing]]), or **Freeze this space** to stop all writes.

## Web app manifest
## mermaid.toSource(input)
Renders the Mermaid source string from this library’s IR format — useful for debugging or freezing a dynamic diagram into a static block. It delegates to `mermaid.serialize`, a **pure Lua** function defined in this library.

## Views
## tag.setRequired(name, attribute, required)
Makes `attribute` required (`true`) or optional (`false`) in the schema of tag `name`, keeping its other required attributes. Because it runs each time configuration loads, it extends a schema defined elsewhere (a built-in tag, a library) without freezing that schema's own required list. The [[Workbench]] writes these calls when you change whether an attribute is required.
